scene.name: Dawn Inspection at Tidegate
scene.summary: Mira reaches the eastern gate with the stolen ledger and finds Jun personally checking arrivals.

goals.goal: Move the ledger past inspection without revealing its contents.
Identify the courier carrying the missing record before the morning convoy clears.

tensions: Jun recognizes the seal pattern on Mira's satchel.
The gate clerks are too overloaded to hide a careful inspection for long.
facts_in_play: The ledger could prove a living succession claim.
The inspection surge began before the public knew the barge was missing.
unknowns: Who ordered the surge before the disappearance was announced?
Can Jun be turned into an ally before he turns procedural?
exit_conditions: Mira passes inspection with the ledger intact.
Mira abandons the gate and takes the flood tunnels.
Jun detains her and forces the conflict into public view.
